The workbook generation failed due to invalid Excel formulas in the statistics section, resulting in #NAME? errors.
The test_derived_values_and_stats failed with an AssertionError in test_outputs.py. Specifically, cells H46 through L47 returned #NAME? instead of the expected floating-point values (e.g., H46 expected -14.74, got #NAME?). This indicates that the formulas used for 'statistics' in the Task worksheet are either using undefined names or functions not recognized by the evaluator. Basic sheet structure and lookup blocks passed, suggesting the core issue is limited to the final statistical calculations.
